name: postulo-chromium
description: Browser extension that sends the job posting you are looking at to your own Postulo. One source, built for Chromium-based browsers and for Firefox.

scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chromium --artifacts-dir dist/artifacts/chromium --overwrite-dest && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir dist/artifacts/firefox --overwrite-dest
scripts.run:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext run --source-dir dist/firefox
